title: [ingest] search_knowledge CI gate: recall@5 >= 0.85, MRR@5 >= 0.80
summary: test/retrieval-quality.test.js is an offline regression guard that rebuilds the injected corpus and asserts aggregate recall@5 >= 0.85 and MRR@5 >= 0.80 (THRESH). A retrieval change that drops below these fails CI.
